key_insight: The paper argues that educational LLM assistants should be modular and agentic rather than monolithic so they can better support responsible, pedagogically aligned learning.
engineering_relevance: For AI education systems, the proposed modular architecture offers a more controllable and transparent way to embed targeted teaching strategies into student-facing exercise-solving tools.
method: Identify desiderata for responsible LLM-based educational systems.
Analyze why out-of-the-box monolithic chatbots are structurally insufficient.
Propose stage-specific modules for exercise-solving that can incorporate pedagogical guidance.
evidence_signal: This is a conceptual design paper grounded in a literature- and theory-based analysis rather than in reported experiments or benchmark results in the abstract.
watch_item: A modular agentic system may be harder to implement consistently across stages and still requires careful oversight to ensure pedagogical advice is applied correctly.
paper_title: Modularizing Educational LLM-Agency for Fostering Responsible Learning Assistance
